UpdateSourceArgs: -c "mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}tools' '{{$FullRootDir}}server' && cd '{{$FullRootDir}}tools' && u='{{ToolsScriptURL}}' && { if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o ampmodpack.sh.new \"$u\"; else wget -q --tries=3 -O ampmodpack.sh.new \"$u\"; fi; } && head -n1 ampmodpack.sh.new | grep -q bash && mv -f ampmodpack.sh.new ampmodpack.sh && chmod +x ampmodpack.sh && echo 'Fetched ampmodpack.sh' || { echo 'Could not download ampmodpack.sh from the template repo'; rm -f ampmodpack.sh.new; [ -f ampmodpack.sh ]; }"
